title: Staring app citizen-science project

tellings.quote: I'm just releasing an app at the moment which works on cell phones uh where you can train yourself to get better at it

plain: In 2024 a phone app was being released so that ordinary people could test, and train, their sense of being stared at. The scientist Rupert Sheldrake describes it as his own project on Jesse Michels's show, saying it is an app "where you can train yourself to get better at it." If it worked, it would suggest that people can feel someone's gaze without seeing it.
